body_markdown:
EWING, N.J.–(BUSINESS WIRE)–


[Universal Display Corporation](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Foled.com&esheet=54630529&newsitemid=20261028444688&lan=en-US&anchor=Universal+Display+Corporation&index=1&md5=e2206896694d43b0de3743c00af4c1db) (Nasdaq: OLED), a global leader in energy-efficient OLED technologies and materials, today announced that its Board of Directors approved a fourth quarter cash dividend of $0.50 per share on the Company’s common stock. The dividend is payable on December 31, 2026, to shareholders of record on December 17, 2026. The dividend reflects our expected continued cash flow generation, and commitment to return capital to our shareholders. Future dividends will be subject to Board approval.
